snippet.title: Trapped Together | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the first public look at Trapped Together.

Trapped Together is a cooperative puzzle game set inside a mysterious sci-fi facility.
What you’re seeing in this trailer are visual prototype test rooms built to explore lighting, materials, and atmosphere. There is no gameplay yet. The goal of our Kickstarter is to fund the development of real puzzles, co-op systems, and full environments.

We’re a small indie team building this step by step, and we’re inviting you to be part of the journey from the very beginning.

Special thanks to our amazing voice actors:
- Victoria Lynn Carroll
- Jeffrey Fukushima
- Joe's Father

👉 Wishlist the game 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316060/Trapped_Together/

🔔 Follow our Kickstarter to get notified when the campaign goes live:
https://bit.ly/tbstudios

🌐 Visit our website:
https://www.tinybrainstudios.com

💬 Join our Discord community:
https://discord.com/invite/ZjZqRNGCyM

📱 Follow us on socials:
https://linktr.ee/tinybrainstudios

Thank you for supporting early indie development.
We’re excited to build this together.

#TrappedTogether #indiegame #gamedev #coopgame #puzzlegame #scifigame #kickstarter #indiegamedev #gaming  #crowdfunding
